ingredients.item: waxy potatoes, cut into 3 cm chunks
lemon, juiced, the spent halves kept

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C fan and tip the potatoes into a roasting tin big enough to hold them in one layer.
Toss the potatoes with 3 tbsp of the oil, the garlic, oregano, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Pour the hot stock around them and tuck the spent lemon halves in among the chunks.
Rub the thighs with the last of the oil and a little salt, then sit them skin side up on the potatoes.
Roast until the skin has tightened and taken its first colour.
Spoon the pan juices over the potatoes, but leave the chicken skin dry so it can crisp.
Roast again until the skin is crisp and the potatoes have drunk most of the stock.
Set the tin on the hob and leave it alone so the juices settle back into the meat.
Scatter over the parsley and serve straight from the tin, spooning the pan juices over each plate.
